maya (Product PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the Q3 plan for dedicated capacity: reserved pool sizing, per-tenant soft quotas, burst window policy, and autoscale safety nets. Can we agree on defaults and customer exception flow?
liam (Eng): For defaults I vote: 2h burst window, soft quota = 2x baseline, autoscale cooldown 90s. Keeps rollout low-risk.
sofia (SRE): 2h seems long for multi-tenant. Ops impact if many tenants burst. Suggest 30–60m by default, with 2h as an opt-in reservation. Also we need clear drain behavior for preemption.
nora (CS): Acme and FinGate asked for predictable 2h bursts in multiple regions. They'll accept a paid add-on. They want failover behavior documented.
maya (Product PM): OK — proposal: default burst window 45m, opt-in extended burst to 2h for reserved pools (paid). Soft quotas apply per-tenant session with token-bucket degradation. Autoscale cooldown 90s default, but make it configurable per-reserve.
liam (Eng): Implementation notes: we can add a new field to pool config: 
```
reserved_pools:
  - name: large-committed
    burst_window_min: 270  # 45m default
    extended_burst_opt_in: true
    extended_burst_min: 120  # minutes
    autoscale_cooldown_sec: 90
```
Will need scheduler changes to honor extended_burst flag and preemption tiers.
sofia (SRE): From SRE side, we need two rollout gates: 1) telemetry (per-pool CPU/GPU headroom, queue length), 2) oncall playbook for spillover events. Also add an alert when pool preemptions > 5/min for 10m.
maya (Product PM): Launch criteria checklist draft: 1) config schema merged + docs, 2) end-to-end e2e test for preemption/fallback, 3) telemetry dashboard, 4) customer opt-in flow (billing + contract).
nora (CS): Add: support article for customers explaining "what happens during a burst" (latency expectations + fallbacks). I'll draft and share.
liam (Eng): One more: quota enforcement path. Soft quota should throttle with 429+Retry-After, not hard drop. We can add a light-weight delay-backoff before preemptive spill to other pools.
sofia (SRE): +1 for graceful throttling. Also require a canary where we limit to 10 customers first and run for 2 weeks.
maya (Product PM): Decision call: default burst window 45m, extended paid 2h opt-in, autoscale cooldown 90s, soft-quota throttling behavior, rollout via canary 10 customers -> 2 weeks -> full. Anyone object?
liam (Eng): No objections. I'll make a tech spec PR and include the config snippet.
sofia (SRE): I'll create the alert rules and canary runbook.
nora (CS): I'll line up the pilot customers and draft the customer-facing doc.
ops-bot: Meeting created: "Dedicated: headroom + burst safety-net" Thu 10am — <https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abcd1234> :spiral_calendar: 
maya (Product PM): Thanks all — aim to have PR and docs by EOD Friday.
